derivation.behavior: Repeated captures converge into bounded logical media graph.
derivation.canonical_behavior: Go graph models media item/source/variant/track/rendition/manifest/fragment-set/protection with provenance.

invariants: Repeated observations of the same manifest through rotated signed URLs converge into one logical item/source.
Audio/video rendition groups are represented as graph entities with provenance.
Protection classification uses deterministic precedence and graph growth is bounded.
